relevance.focus: Detecting toxic, harmful or jailbreak content with or in large language models. Exclude image-only and speech-only models.
relevance.note: Labels are judgements: true = should be selected, false = should be rejected. Borderline cases were left out.

items.title: GradSafe: Detecting Jailbreak Prompts for LLMs via Safety-Critical Gradient Analysis
items.abstract: We propose GradSafe, which detects jailbreak prompts by analysing the gradients of safety-critical parameters in LLMs.

items.title: Efficient Detection of Toxic Prompts in Large Language Models
items.abstract: ToxicDetector is a lightweight greybox method that detects toxic prompts using LLM embeddings and an MLP classifier.

items.title: Toxic Text Classification in Portuguese: Is LLaMA 3.1 8B All You Need?
items.abstract: We fine-tune LLaMA 3.1 8B for toxic and hate speech classification in Portuguese and compare with BERTimbau.

items.title: RLShield: Dynamic Jailbreak Detection for LLMs via Reinforced Adaptive Learning
items.abstract: A reinforcement-learning based detector that adapts to new jailbreak strategies against large language models.

items.title: Large Language Models for Toxic Language Detection in Low-Resource Languages
items.abstract: We evaluate LLM-based toxic language classifiers on low-resource languages with few labelled examples.

items.title: An Adversarial Toxicity Prompt Generator Exploiting Multilingual Code-Switching
items.abstract: We generate code-switched adversarial toxic prompts and use them to test whether LLM toxicity detectors can be evaded.

items.title: Detecting NSFW Images with Vision Transformers
items.abstract: An image-only classifier based on vision transformers that flags explicit pictures on social platforms.
items.why: image-only model: excluded by the focus

items.title: Speech-Based Hate Detection with Wav2Vec 2.0
items.abstract: We classify hateful spoken utterances directly from audio with a self-supervised speech model, without transcripts.
items.why: speech-only model: excluded by the focus

items.title: Protein Structure Prediction with Diffusion Models
items.abstract: We apply diffusion models to predict three-dimensional protein structures.

items.title: Image-Based Diagnosis of Oral Lesions: Performance of a Vision-Language Model
items.abstract: We evaluate a vision-language model for diagnosing oral lesions from clinical photographs.

items.title: Cooking with Large Language Models: Recipe Generation at Scale
items.abstract: We use large language models to generate and rank cooking recipes for home cooks.

items.title: The emerging use of artificial intelligence in safety pharmacology
items.abstract: A review of AI methods for predicting drug toxicity in preclinical safety pharmacology.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
items.abstract: We study how language model loss scales with model size, dataset size and compute.

items.title: A Survey of Hate Speech and Toxicity Detection Datasets for LLM Evaluation
items.abstract: We review datasets used to train and evaluate large language models for hate speech and toxicity detection.
